fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance. The building is a small multi-tenant-style flex/industrial unit in the Scottsdale Airpark business park; access is via open, ungated business-park drive aisles and a shared surface parking lot.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth - open business-park site.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: No dock apron visible; servicing is at grade. Likely 1-2 grade-level overhead doors on the building - low confidence, set to 0-10 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No trailer parking - NONE. Some pallets/equipment staged in the surface lot, but no marked trailer stalls or drop yard.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Only a short open drive aisle off the parking lot serves the building - no queue depth.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Small parcel, ~0.7 acre - a 10,000 sq ft building plus shared surface parking.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Scottsdale Airpark, within the Phoenix metro - Urban.
fieldNotes.facility-character: Roster correctly notes this is a low-priority equipment/dispensing operation (~10,000 sq ft, ~23 employees) that builds branded bulk dispensing equipment for International Delight/Silk/SToK - not a high-volume freight yard. No truck-yard infrastructure present.
